summary: Feed c016_crc to IDS is degraded due to high CRC/alignment errors on ingress link VF-1 port 1. 3,720 damaged frames (error rate 0.001088 > threshold 1e-05) indicate physical layer fault, causing corrupted traffic to IDS and reduced detection coverage. Path loss check is healthy.

findings.root_cause: VF-1 port 1 (input) is receiving damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors (3,720 frames, error rate 0.001088 vs threshold 0.00001). Most likely root cause is a faulty cable, bad optic/SFP, or duplex/speed mismatch on the link into VF-1 port 1, corrupting frames before the packet broker can forward them.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires complete, correct traffic with full payload and both directions. Corrupted frames are dropped or truncated by NIC/broker, so IDS misses payload for signature matching and flow reassembly, creating blind spots and allowing attacks to evade detection.

recommended_fix.why: Fix physical layer first - inspect/replace cable and optics on VF-1 port 1, verify speed/duplex autonegotiation, check error counters, and re-test. No broker policy change will fix CRC-damaged frames; link must be clean to restore complete traffic to IDS.
